title: Add DoseLogging.editDose()
description: DoseLogging is an object, not a class -- structure_type method's parent resolution only matches 'class'/'interface' keywords, not 'object' (confirmed: it failed with "symbol not found: class 'DoseLogging'"), so this uses function/add with an explicit anchor instead, same as ExactAlarmScheduler's members were authored in an earlier phase. The anchor '    }' (4-space indent) is logDose's own closing brace -- verified as the only line in this file at that exact indentation, so the new method lands right after logDose and before the object's own closing brace. Shared logic for editing an existing dose log's amount/time: recomputes nextEligibleAtEpochMillis from the new time, persists the update, then 'clears and relaunches' the reminder -- always cancels the existing alarm for this doseLogId first (the old nextEligible is stale regardless), then reschedules only if a next-eligible time still exists and the live Settings default has notifications on. No too-soon confirmation here by design: editing is the user knowingly correcting a specific record, not logging a fresh dose that could collide with another caregiver's.
acceptance_criteria: suspend fun editDose(context: Context, doseLogRepository: DoseLogRepository, medicationRepository: MedicationRepository, settingsRepository: SettingsRepository, doseLog: DoseLog, doseAmount: String, givenAtEpochMillis: Long)

Calls doseLogRepository.update(doseLog.copy(doseAmount = doseAmount, givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis, nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible)) -- id/profileId/medicationId/wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged unchanged
Unconditionally calls ExactAlarmScheduler.cancel(context, doseLog.id) before deciding whether to reschedule
Reads notifyOnNextDose from settingsRepository.settings.first().notificationsEnabled (no override parameter -- there's no per-edit toggle in the UI)

If notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null, builds the reminder via ReminderMessage.build(context, medication.name, nextEligible) and calls ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(context, doseLog.id, nextEligible, title, text, doseLog.profileId, doseLog.medicationId, medication.defaultDose)
No timing/too-soon check and no new DoseLog row is inserted -- this only updates the existing row
exact_code:
suspend fun editDose(
        context: Context,
        doseLogRepository: DoseLogRepository,
        medicationRepository: MedicationRepository,
        settingsRepository: SettingsRepository,
        doseLog: DoseLog,
        doseAmount: String,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
    ) {
        val medication = medicationRepository.getById(doseLog.medicationId)
        val nextEligible = DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(
            givenAtEpochMillis,
            medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
        )
        doseLogRepository.update(
            doseLog.copy(
                doseAmount = doseAmount,
                givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible,
            ),
        )
        ExactAlarmScheduler.cancel(context, doseLog.id)
        val notifyOnNextDose = settingsRepository.settings.first().notificationsEnabled
        if (notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null) {
            val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(context, medication.name, nextEligible)
            ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(
                context,
                doseLog.id,
                nextEligible,
                title,
                text,
                doseLog.profileId,
                doseLog.medicationId,
                medication.defaultDose,
            )
        }
    }
